attributes.title: PSSCA Conference 2027: Amplify Your Impact
attributes.series: Palmetto State School Counselor Association Conference
attributes.summary:
South Carolina's school counselors meet at the Palmetto State School Counselor Association conference from January 28 to 30, 2027, at the Embassy Suites Resort & Convention Center in Myrtle Beach. The theme is "Amplify Your Impact." A pre-conference on January 28 features Amy Baltimore on student belonging and Teshia Stovall Dula on trauma-informed discipline, and Kat Pastor gives the January 29 keynote on protecting educator mental health and avoiding burnout.

The main conference costs $164 for professional members, $94 for student or retiree members and $214 for non-members through the early deadline of November 30, 2026, rising by $20 after that; the pre-conference is priced separately. Advance registration closes January 25, 2027, and member rates require PSSCA membership valid through the end of the conference.

The hotel block is $168 per night plus resort fee and parking, with breakfast included, until December 28, 2026, which is also the last day for refunds. The conference page does not yet list continuing education or recertification hours, so school counselors who need NBCC or state renewal credit should check back as the page is completed.
